project.name: vllm-ascend
project.what: An out-of-tree (OOT) hardware plugin that integrates Huawei Ascend NPU (910B/A2, 910C/A3, 310P, 950/A5) with upstream vLLM, providing device kernels, attention backends, quantization, distributed communication, graph capture and scheduling extensions.
project.problem_solved: vLLM targets NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) and ROCm. Ascend NPUs have a different device API (torch_npu / CANN / HCCL), different memory allocator, different graph API (ACL graph instead of CUDA graph), different KV-cache storage layouts (FRACTAL_NZ), and different operator sets. vllm-ascend bridges these gaps without forking vLLM, using the pluggable hardware interface plus monkey-patching.
integration_mechanism: setup.py entry points: vllm.platform_plugins -> vllm_ascend:register; vllm.general_plugins -> register_connector / register_model_loader / register_service_profiling / register_model
register() returns 'vllm_ascend.platform.NPUPlatform' which vLLM instantiates as the current active platform
NPUPlatform.pre_register_and_update() applies global (platform) patches; each worker applies local (worker) patches in NPUWorker.__init__
Where the pluggable interface is insufficient, vllm-ascend monkey-patches upstream vLLM classes via vllm_ascend/patch/platform/ and vllm_ascend/patch/worker/

core_modules.responsibility: NPUPlatform, the central hardware-abstraction entry point registered with vLLM. Implements the Platform ABC, validates/rewrites VllmConfig for Ascend, selects attention backend, worker class, compiler and graph wrapper, and installs Ascend-specific forward context.

Hardware abstraction and capability contracts. hardware.py (AscendDeviceType families A2/A3/310P/A5), device_config.py (build/runtime device detection), hardware_profile.py (semantic HardwareProfile with capability sets), device_op.py (operator ABI adaptors Base/A5/310P), utils.py (FIA large-head fallback).

NPU worker and model runners. worker.py (NPUWorker), model_runner_v1.py (NPUModelRunner v1), v2/model_runner.py (NPUModelRunner v2), block_table.py / v2/block_table.py (int32 slot mapping, DCP/hybrid/ring KV), npu_input_batch.py / v2/input_batch.py, DCP/PCP managers, v2 spec-decode speculators and ACL graph managers.

Ascend attention backends: GQA (attention_v1), MLA (mla_v1), sparse Flash MLA (sfa_v1), DeepSeek Sparse Attention (dsa_v1/dsa_v41), FA3 (fa3_v1), SFA indexer (indexer.py), context-parallel composition (PCP/DCP/DSA-CP), and attention mask builders.
ACL graph capture/replay, breakable graphs, updatable host-side graphs, Ascend compiler backend and graph-fusion passes (muls_add, norm+quant, qknorm+rope, allgather-chunk noop, noop elimination).

NPU device communicator over HCCL, Ascend parallel groups (KVPP/MC2/OTP/LMTP/EMBED/P-TP), KV transfer connectors (P2P Mooncake, KV pool AscendStore/UCM, CPU offload, sparse KV offload), EC transfer, weight transfer (HCCL broadcast / NPU IPC), and EPLB (Gloo staged communicator, AscendEplbState, STAIR/default policy).
CaMemAllocator (NPU pluggable allocator backed by CANN mem, tag-based sleep/wake) and SleepWakeupManager (KV cache, ACL graph, HCCL lifecycle across sleep levels).
Ascend KV-cache spec registration and scheduler extensions: batch-job-aware, DyntraLB, recompute, short-request-first, profiling-chunk dynamic chunk sizing, and KVPP placement.

Quantization configs (modelslim 'ascend', compressed-tensors, fp8, modelopt mxfp8) and registered per-(quant_type, layer_type) schemes covering W8A8/W4A8/W4A16/W4A4/MXFP variants plus INT8/C8 KV cache.
NPU sampler, top-k/top-p sampler, penalties and rejection sampler with Triton kernels avoiding CPU-NPU sync.
Speculative-decoding proposers (Eagle/Eagle3, MTP, DFlash, DFlash2, DSpark, NGram, Medusa, Suffix, Step3.5, Gemma4, extract-hidden-states) built on AscendSpecDecodeBaseProposer.
Triton/kernel warmup orchestration (kernel_warmup, early kernel warmup, NZ warmup) and prefetch CPU offloader with FRACTAL_NZ static buffers.
Custom model loaders registered as general plugins: netloader (elastic network weight loading) and rfork (distributed seed/session based loader).

NPU-native model implementations for architectures not fully supported upstream: DeepSeek-V4, DeepSeek-V4.1 (incl. Engram), GLM-5-Next, MiniMax-M3, Kimi-K3, plus MTP/Eagle3/DSpark/Dflash helpers. models/layer/attention/layer.py defines DSAAttention.

Custom operators and fused MoE stack: fused_moe router/dispatcher/runner, triton kernels (FLA/KDA/mamba/spec-decode/v2 sampling/linearnorm), activation/layernorm/linear/rotary/MLA/GDN ops and register_custom_ops.

Monkey-patch catalog split into platform (applied pre-worker via NPUPlatform.pre_register_and_update -> adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True)) and worker (applied in NPUWorker.__init__ -> adapt_patch(is_global_patch=False)).

Ascend 310P compatibility implementation family: NPUWorker310/NPUModelRunner310, AscendAttentionBackend310 with 16-aligned KV shape, W8A8-only quantization, ALLGATHER MoE comm, FORCE_NZ weight layout, RC device handling.
openEuler Xlite virtualization backend worker/runner (selected when xlite_graph_config.enabled).
Service metrics provider registered via ms_service_metric.providers entry point.

NPUPlatform_registration_flow.problem: vLLM must discover and use a non-CUDA backend.
workflow: Python packaging exposes entry point vllm.platform_plugins -> 'ascend = vllm_ascend:register' (setup.py).
vLLM plugin loader calls vllm_ascend.register(), which returns the string 'vllm_ascend.platform.NPUPlatform'.
vLLM resolves and instantiates NPUPlatform, setting it as current_platform.
NPUPlatform.pre_register_and_update() runs adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True) to install platform-level monkey patches before engine-core init.
NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config() rewrites incompatible config values, initializes AscendConfig, selects compile backend/worker/scheduler and sets the NPU allocator env.
vllm.general_plugins additionally register connector/model-loader/profiling/model entry points, each of which calls _ensure_global_patch() for subprocess safety.

patch_mechanism.problem: Some upstream behavior cannot be expressed through the platform plugin interface.
workflow: Platform patches: vllm_ascend/patch/platform/__init__.py imports each patch module at import time; applied via adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True).
Worker patches: vllm_ascend/patch/worker/__init__.py imports each patch module; applied via adapt_patch(is_global_patch=False).
adapt_patch() is called from NPUPlatform.pre_register_and_update (platform, for engine-core child processes) and NPUWorker.__init__ (worker).
Each patch monkey-patches an upstream class/function/property. Idempotency and spawn-safety are handled per patch.
Conditional application uses HardwareCapability (e.g. STANDARD_MAMBA_PATCH, STANDARD_WORKER_PATCHES) and env vars (DYNAMIC_EPLB).

ACL_graph_vs_CUDA_graph.problem: NPU has no CUDA Graph; it has ACL/GE graphs.
workflow: CUDA Graph -> torch.npu.NPUGraph; torch.cuda.graph -> torch.npu.graph(aclgraph, pool=...)
graph_pool_handle -> current_platform.get_global_graph_pool() / torch.npu.graph_pool_handle
A compatibility shim in worker/v2/utils.py reassigns torch.cuda.CUDAGraph/graph/graph_pool_handle to NPU equivalents for upstream breakable-graph code.
ACLGraphWrapper caches an NPU graph per BatchDescriptor; capture runs the runnable inside torch.npu.graph; replay calls aclgraph.replay().
Full/decode graphs synchronize the current NPU stream before replay to order async attention-parameter updates; UpdatableGraph performs host-side task updates.
Piecewise graphs are wrapped by vLLM via get_static_graph_wrapper_cls(); FULL graphs are wrapped by the Ascend runner.
NZ format handling: weights/KV can be cast to ACL_FORMAT_FRACTAL_NZ (NZ_FMT_LAST_DIM=32); C8 KV uses an NZ 5-D view (num_blocks, num_kv_heads, head_size//32, block_size, 32).

AscendAttentionBackend_NZ_and_kv_shape.problem: Ascend kernels expect different KV cache shapes and NZ storage than CUDA.
workflow: GQA returns (2, num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_size) by default; HND/LBHNC layout swaps block and head axes to (2, num_blocks, num_kv_heads, block_size, head_size).
MLA/SFA/DSA/indexer return a single-tensor latent/indexer cache (no leading 2): (num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_size).
Kernel block sizes are Ascend-specific: GQA/MLA/SFA = [128]; DSA variants use [2..128], [128,256,512], [4096,8192,16384], etc.
FRACTAL_NZ is applied at storage/operator level (torch_npu.npu_format_cast, _nz_5d_view), not in the shape tuple.
Backends are selected in NPUPlatform.get_attn_backend_cls by (use_mla, use_sparse, use_compress), with a compatibility (310P) map and an FA3 short-circuit.

NPUModelRunner_vs_GPUModelRunner.problem: The NPU runner must override graph capture, metadata, allocator, sampler and parallelism.
workflow: v1 NPUModelRunner(GPUModelRunner) overrides ~40 methods and adds DCP/PCP managers, EPLB, KVPP, sparse offload, FIA query padding and Ascend KV tensor allocation.

Signature deltas vs upstream: profile_run() drops randomize_inputs; initialize_kv_cache()/initialize_attn_backend() drop is_profiling; _model_forward() takes a leading num_tokens_padded; _dummy_run() adds with_prefill/profile_cpp/skip_gdn_state_update; capture_model() returns graph-pool bytes.
v2 NPUModelRunner inherits the modular vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_runner.GPUModelRunner and deletes/rebuilds req_states, input_buffers and speculator with Ascend types.
Both use NPUInputBatch/BlockTable with int32 slot mapping (upstream uses int64) because Ascend reshape_and_cache requires int32.

EPLB_load_balancing.problem: MoE expert load is uneven across ranks; experts can be replicated and moved.
workflow: MoE layers register with VllmEplbAdaptor, which collects per-layer weight tensors and swap buffers.
Each step, EplbUpdator.forward_end gathers moe_load over the dynamic-EPLB group into a shared dict and wakes the EplbProcess.
The policy (Random/Default/Swift/FlashLB legacy; default/stair new) rebalances experts and produces packed send/recv update plans.
D2DExpertWeightLoader issues async dist.batch_isend_irecv P2P transfers and commits updated expert maps/weights.

New async path: AscendEplbState computes temporal load stats (STAIR bins) and AscendGlooEplbCommunicator stages transfers over Gloo CPU pinned buffers; upstream EPLB capability is injected via patch_eplb.

CaMem_allocator.problem: PyTorch's default allocator cannot unmap/remap NPU memory for sleep mode/RL.
workflow: Installs torch.npu.memory.NPUPluggableAllocator (backed by the vllm_ascend_C extension) as the NPU pluggable allocator.
Allocations are tagged (default / sleep_persistent) inside use_memory_pool(tag).
sleep(offload_tags) unmaps matching allocations (optionally backing up to pinned CPU memory via acl.rt.memcpy) and drops the rest; wake_up remaps them.
Rejects expandable_segments:True; SleepWakeupManager coordinates KV, ACL graph and HCCL teardown/restore.

hardware_platform_differences.A2 (910B): STANDARD attention, TOPO_AFFINITY CPU binding, DIRECT addressing, CAPACITY_AND_EXPERT_DENSITY MoE policy, NPU_TOP_K_TOP_P.
hardware_platform_differences.A3 (910C): STANDARD attention, GLOBAL_SLICE CPU binding, DUAL_CHIP_CARD addressing, FUSED_OR_CAPACITY MoE policy, MC2_FULLMESH_V2_COMM + CANN_MEGAMOE.
hardware_platform_differences.310P: COMPATIBILITY attention (16-aligned KV shape), FORCE_NZ weights, ALLGATHER MoE comm, W8A8-only quantization, RC device discovery, NPUWorker310/NPUModelRunner310.
hardware_platform_differences.A5 (950): FP8_OPTIMIZED adaptor, CAPACITY_AND_WORLD_SIZE MoE policy, FP8/MXFP/DSV4/mega-moe capabilities, A5DeviceAdaptor with npu_scatter_pa_cache.

platform.why: PR #45026 removed per-process device isolation; upstream helper expects ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES to contain all devices and applies local_dp_rank*world_size offset, causing IndexError with a pre-sharded env var.

platform.why: PD-disaggregated decode serving can develop uneven attention KV-cache load across DP ranks; upstream exposes no extension point for an Ascend DP engine core.

platform.why: Previously balance/dyntra/profiling patches each wrapped run_engine_core independently forming an order-dependent wrapper chain; profiling patch was conditionally imported so child-process re-application could fail.
platform.how: Install a single run_engine_core wrapper that init ascend config, re-applies profiling patches when enabled, selects DyntraLBDPEngineCoreProc or BalanceDPEngineCoreProc at runtime, then delegates to the pristine upstream entry point stashed at import.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes stable engine-core extension points.

platform.why: Upstream Engram validation requires CUDA before the platform hook.
platform.how: Keep upstream model/layer checks, lift only the CUDA requirement; Ascend supplies defaults and checks model/topology/loader limits in its platform hook.
platform.future_plan: Remove once pinned vLLM includes the change.

platform.why: Upstream EPLB capability check excludes NPU and its async workspace move has no downstream callback after per-layer commit.
platform.how: Expose EPLB capability only inside vllm.config.parallel and refresh Ascend lookup after async layer commit; upstream torch.distributed comm runs over HCCL.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream EplbPlatformBackend interface is available.

platform.why: Models import FusedMoEFactory directly; on Ascend it must be redirected to AscendMoERunner before model import. DeepSeek-V4 vision routing supplies bias_vl and image_sentinel_lo that must be preserved.
platform.how: Patch the FusedMoEFactory binding in package __init__ and layer module; worker patch reuses it idempotently.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes a MoE runner dispatch/plugin hook.

platform.why: GLM-5.3-Flash configs are maintained in vllm-ascend and absent from vLLM's model_type lookup; upstream is_deepseek_mla uses a hard-coded model_type tuple.
platform.how: Insert Glm5NextConfig/Glm5NextTextConfig/Glm5NextVisionConfig into _CONFIG_REGISTRY; wrap is_deepseek_mla to return True for glm5_next/glm5_next_text with kv_lora_rank.
platform.future_plan: Remove once supported vLLM registers GLM-5.3-Flash.

platform.why: PD hybrid Mamba: upstream min-reduction across groups collapses FullAttention hit to 0 on D side; and EAGLE last-block drop erases the shared prefix on pure producers, pinning prefix hits to 0.
platform.how: Override per-group lookup to report FullAttention hit directly; attach live kv_transfer_config to KVCacheConfig and skip the EAGLE drop on a pure producer.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes the PD role to the coordinator.

platform.why: vLLM PR #40860 forbids hybrid KV groups with multiple block sizes + decode context parallelism; correct for CUDA but not Ascend.
platform.how: Return lcm(block_sizes)*dcp as scheduler_block_size instead of raising.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports hybrid KV cache + CP for non-CUDA backends or exposes a platform hook.

platform.why: On a PD decode consumer a 1+K speculative window split at the next block boundary can be narrower than the advertised placeholder; upstream also backs off the last cacheable mamba-align page while EAGLE drop is active, leaving final state page unhashed.
platform.how: Return the complete requested width on KV consumers; on a pure PD producer suppress the EAGLE drop bit for the duration of the call.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream preserves speculative window atomicity / splits mamba-align pages correctly.

platform.why: vLLM sets block size 16, unsupported by Ascend.
platform.how: Set block size to 128 on NPU.
platform.future_plan: Remove when vLLM merges.

platform.why: 310P requires attention page size >= mamba page size and 128-token kernel alignment.
platform.how: Align mamba_block_size and attention block size to 128 on 310P.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports 310P-aligned mamba block sizing.

platform.why: Upstream hybrid prefix cache lookup does not support DCP; get_num_blocks_to_allocate returns wrong count on external cache hit.
platform.how: Replace MambaManager with AscendMambaManager for prefix cache lookup; override get_num_blocks_to_allocate.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream includes DCP hybrid lookup and fixes the block-count bug.

platform.why: MiniMax-M2 fp8 validation differs; HCCL op expansion affects graph capture; eagle3 whitelist rejects MiniMax; some draft checkpoints use MiniMax-specific arch strings.
platform.how: Force quantization=None for MiniMax-M2 fp8 on NPU; default HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV; bypass eagle3 whitelist; register Eagle3MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM alias.
platform.future_plan: Remove when upstream supports MiniMax-M2 fp8 on NPU and whitelist includes MiniMax.

platform.why: PR #32623 introduces MLAPrefillBackend; upstream selector falls back to FlashAttnPrefillBackend and asserts on Ascend.
platform.how: Register a no-op AscendMLAPrefillBackend; AscendSFAImpl/AscendMLAImpl handles prefill via impl.forward().
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream provides a platform hook.

platform.why: vLLM child processes use daemon=True, incompatible with EPLB spawning a subprocess.
platform.how: Set daemon=False.
platform.future_plan: Remove when vLLM fixes the issue.

platform.why: PP+MTP mixed deployment needs spec_token_ids on ModelRunnerOutput; PP batch queue + sync scheduling calls post_step with stale request state; PP async needs request-level in-flight fence; Ascend routes PP sampled-token handoff through scheduler IPC; local Eagle/MTP drafters run with effective PP=1.
platform.how: Add backward-compatible spec_token_ids; skip post_step in PP+MTP+batch-queue+sync; add decode fence and output-owned spec writeback; build cached request data with sync-PP semantics; verify draft configs with pipeline_parallel_size=1.
platform.future_plan: Remove when upstream makes spec token writeback output-owned and supports local drafters with PP>1.

platform.why: Profiling-based dynamic chunk sizing needs a one-shot profiling pass after model_executor is ready and per-step latency feedback; monkey-patches are lost in spawn children.
platform.how: Replace EngineCore.__init__ to call run_profiling_chunk_init; wrap scheduler.update_from_output to record execution time; module-level _apply_profiling_patches re-runs in spawn children.
platform.future_plan: Remove/narrow if upstream exposes backend profiling startup and per-step timing hooks.

platform.why: MTP draft models (DeepSeek-V3/V4, Pangu, MiMo, GLM4-MoE, ERNIE, Nemotron-H, Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5, Exaone, LongCat-Flash, Step3.5/3.7) load as MTP layers needing remap; DeepSeek-V4 vision conversion can overwrite DSparkDraftModel arch; pinned vLLM propagates enable_expert_parallel to dense drafts.
platform.how: Replace hf_config_override to remap model_type/architectures and derive n_predict; restore DSparkDraftModel arch after init; skip expert-parallel check for non-MoE drafts.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports these MTP draft models and disables EP for dense drafts.

platform.why: backend=auto can mix xgrammar/guidance in one engine; outlines FSM rejects the extra EOS/stop mask after JSON completion.
platform.how: Record first resolved backend and reject mixed backend; guard grammar_init; add terminal short-circuit to outlines accept_tokens mirroring xgrammar.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream enforces backend consistency and adds outlines short-circuit.

platform.why: torch.accelerator does not route to the NPU backend, so upstream memory APIs fail on Ascend.
platform.how: Monkey-patch torch.accelerator memory APIs to torch.npu equivalents; patch empty_cache.
platform.future_plan: Remove once torch.accelerator routes to NPU.

platform.why: v0.23.0 can serialize empty tool_calls:[] which OpenAI-compatible SDKs expect omitted.
platform.how: Wrap model_dump/model_dump_json to drop empty tool_calls from message/delta.
platform.future_plan: Remove once supported vLLM contains PR #44105.

platform.why: Upstream enables v2 runner via architecture whitelists, Triton, and feature checks; Ascend v2 is not compatible with all defaults. PCP+DP validator was release-specific.
platform.how: Override property to read only envs.VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER; release-only validator override removed at v0.30.0 boundary.
platform.future_plan: Remove once vllm-ascend fully supports v2 runner.

platform.why: vllm-ascend bundles PyTorch 2.10 which requires batch_norm eps>0 while upstream passes eps=0.0.
platform.how: Monkey-patch forward to use eps=1e-5; guarded with contextlib.suppress(ImportError).
platform.future_plan: Remove once bundled PyTorch >= 2.13.0.

platform.why: Ascend uses int8 indexer K cache but upstream Literal rejects int8 before it reaches kv_cache_dtype_str_to_dtype.
platform.how: Widen the Literal to include int8 across the module symbol, __annotations__ and __dataclass_fields__ then rebuild_dataclass(force=True); idempotent.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream IndexerKVDType includes int8.

platform.why: Release validator rejected PCP+DP; upstream requires DP>1 for MoE sequence parallelism while Ascend FlashComm supports TP/EP DP=1.
platform.how: First override removed at v0.30.0 boundary; replace use_sequence_parallel_moe with upstream predicate minus the DP>1 condition.
platform.future_plan: Remove once upstream provides a backend capability hook for MoE SP with DP=1.

worker.why: releases/v0.27.1 lacks pluggable kv-cache-dtype; upstream maps fp8 to torch.uint8 but Ascend MLA/DSA needs torch.float8_e4m3fn.
worker.how: If register_kv_cache_dtype is unavailable, mutate STR_DTYPE_TO_TORCH_DTYPE['fp8'] to torch.float8_e4m3fn in every worker.
worker.future_plan: Remove once pluggable kv-cache-dtype lands on the target release.

worker.why: vLLM FULL mode errors on Ascend.
worker.how: Dynamically replace _create_padded_batch_descriptor at runtime and change the if condition.
worker.future_plan: Remove when vLLM merges the PR.

worker.why: GLM-5.2 omits Indexer weights on shared-indexer layers; GLM-5.1 IndexCache skips top-k but keeps per-layer weights; MTP layers must never start in skip mode.
worker.how: Skip Indexer construction only when a layer skips top-k and is marked shared; mask skip_topk with not is_mtp_layer.
worker.future_plan: Remove when depending on a vLLM version including PR #45895.

worker.why: Upstream computes target_layer_num via get_num_layers (per-PP-stage), producing wrong start_layer_id prefixes and target_layer_count under PP>1.
worker.how: Use get_total_num_hidden_layers() instead.
worker.future_plan: Remove once upstream computes target_layer_num from total layers.

targets: Eagle3 target inner models (DeepseekV2Model, EagleModelMixin) forward/make_empty_intermediate_tensors
worker.why: With Eagle3 + PP, aux hidden states span multiple PP stages and combine_hidden_states fails with a k-axis shape mismatch.
worker.how: Wrap forward/make_empty_intermediate_tensors to propagate aux states in IntermediateTensors across PP stages.
worker.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports cross-stage aux state collection.

worker.why: Worker re-imports the factory already patched by platform patch; re-applying would double-wrap.
worker.how: Reuse platform/patch_fused_moe.py idempotently during worker init.
worker.future_plan: Remove together with the platform patch.

worker.why: 310P needs Ascend-friendly Qwen GDN chunk helpers, tail-slot protection for MTP input shift, GDN-specific state/backend wiring, and blocking H2D rot_pos_emb on RC.
worker.how: Replace upstream FLA helpers and GDN methods with 310P implementations; bind rot_pos_emb_310 on RC.
worker.future_plan: Remove when upstream exposes stable 310P hooks.

worker.why: forward uses interpolate with ops unsupported on NPU.
worker.how: Replace with CPU interpolate on shape mismatch and use get_rope_shape.
worker.future_plan: Remove when vLLM aligns with latest main.

worker.why: Upstream batch_memcpy_kernel bugs on Ascend; BLOCK_SIZE 1024 is suboptimal; preprocess_mamba asserts and copies previous-step state too early for layerwise KV transfer.
worker.how: Fix kernel, change BLOCK_SIZE to 8192, remove the assert and collect per-layer copy metadata for layerwise transfer.
worker.future_plan: Remove when vLLM supports mamba KV transfer and dispatches batch_memcpy_kernel.

worker.why: TP reduction path, fused split-qkv+RMSNorm+rope kernel, and fp8 per-block inverse-scale dequantization are needed on NPU.
worker.how: Use experts.maybe_all_reduce_tensor_model_parallel; call torch.ops.vllm.split_qkv_tp_rmsnorm_rope; dequantize fp8+weight_scale_inv to bf16 at load.
worker.future_plan: Move upstream or remove when backend hooks exist.

worker.why: Qwen3_5 reuses Qwen3NextGatedDeltaNet._forward_core but ascendC ops do not support float32 ssm_state.
worker.how: Patch _forward_core to use triton ops like fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule.
worker.future_plan: Remove when all ops support both models.

worker.why: Function calls ops.rms_norm and ops.rotary_embedding with no NPU implementation.
worker.how: Replace ops.* with vllm-ascend internal implementations.
worker.future_plan: Remove when vllm-ascend supports ops.* pattern matching.

worker.why: bind_kv_cache raises when current_platform is npu.
worker.how: Replace with a version that skips the raise.
worker.future_plan: Remove after discussing with vLLM community.

worker.why: Qwen3-VL-MoE checks LM PP boundary on non-first ranks but keeps start/end layer only on the inner model; fused triton split_qkv_rmsnorm_mrope needed for mrope.
worker.how: Expose start_layer/end_layer properties forwarding to inner model; override forward to use triton_split_qkv_rmsnorm_mrope when using mrope.
worker.future_plan: Remove when upstream exposes PP boundaries and supports pattern matching for the fused kernel.

worker.why: Some rejection_sampler functions are unsupported or slow on NPU.
worker.how: Add npu_top_k_top_p to apply_sampling_constraints; add custom triton kernels for expand_batch_to_tokens and rejection_sample.
worker.future_plan: Turn into AscendRejectionSampler overrides or custom ops, then remove patch.

worker.why: Upstream capture does not support Ascend MoE comm types ALLTOALL and MC2 (SP + modular-kernel splitting/all-gather, uneven TP distribution, MC2 padding).
worker.how: Override capture to branch on _EXTRA_CTX.moe_comm_type and compute gather_topk_ids_shape for ALLTOALL/MC2 plus correct tensor_split/all_gather.
worker.future_plan: Remove when upstream supports MoE comm type abstraction.

worker.why: Step uses Gemmanorm (fusion pass cannot match) and two attention layer kinds with different q_head counts (shape mismatch in split op); upstream Step3.5/3.7 lacks SP support.
worker.how: Monkey-patch forward to enable split_qkv_rmsnorm_rope; patch Step3p5 to enable SP.
worker.future_plan: Remove once torch.compile matches patterns from op params and upstream SP refactor completes.

worker.why: Triton ops in vLLM perform poorly on NPU and there is no dispatch mechanism; torch_npu Triton lacks next_power_of_2; FLA KDA kernels are CUDA Triton.
worker.how: Override triton ops with Ascend implementations; inject next_power_of_2; rebind FLA kda entry points to vllm_ascend.ops.triton.kda.
worker.future_plan: Remove when vLLM supports triton ops dispatch.

worker.why: v2 worker uses shared upstream v1 helper returning generic MLAAttentionSpec instead of AscendMLAAttentionSpec; SFA indexer cache needs Ascend cache-only backend.
worker.how: Monkey-patch get_kv_cache_spec to rewrite MLA layers to AscendMLAAttentionSpec (with FA-quant head adjustment); route indexer cache to AscendSFAIndexerBackend.
worker.future_plan: Remove once upstream adds a KV spec backend hook.

worker.why: vllm-ascend needs int32 slot mapping; vLLM default is int64.
worker.how: Replace with AscendBlockTables initializing slot mapping as torch.int32.
worker.future_plan: Remove when Ascend BlockTables can use int64.

worker.why: v2 DFlash spec-decode uses upstream CUDA graph manager, unusable on Ascend.
worker.how: Replace with Ascend DFlashAclGraphManager (ACL graph).
worker.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes a backend-dispatchable spec-decode graph manager.

worker.why: Shared v2 autoregressive (Eagle/MTP) spec-decode uses upstream CUDA graph manager.
worker.how: Replace with AutoRegressiveAclGraphManager (ACL graph).
worker.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes a backend-dispatchable graph manager.

worker.why: vLLM InputBatch makes dummy tensors in model_runner and cudagraph_utils, hard to inherit.
worker.how: Replace with AscendInputBatch.
worker.future_plan: Remove when Ascend make_dummy aligns with vLLM.

worker.why: vLLM ModelState prepare_attn differs from Ascend needs.
worker.how: Define AscendModelState and initialize it in init_model_state.
worker.future_plan: Remove when attention metadata aligns with vLLM.

worker.why: Target-driven spec decoding generates next-step draft tokens after target sampling; non-last PP ranks need both results for the delayed request-state update.
worker.how: Defer target-token broadcast until drafting finishes, then carry accepted target tokens and next-step draft tokens in the same V2 PP queue slot.
worker.future_plan: Remove when vLLM natively transports draft tokens through PP.

worker.why: Triton ops perform poorly or fail on NPU; libdevice imports CUDA symbols; thinking-budget/sampling-mask kernels hit Triton-Ascend compiler limits (UB overflow, TTIR materialization, chained conditions).
worker.how: Override with Ascend implementations, rebind libdevice to triton.language.extra.cann.libdevice, rewrite helper to masked loads + tl.where, use 4096-element tile and int32 keep mask for sampling mask.
worker.future_plan: Remove when vLLM supports triton dispatch and new Triton-Ascend releases resolve compiler issues.

worker.why: EngineCore subprocesses load global/platform patches while workers also import this compatibility module.
worker.how: Reuse platform/patch_use_v2_model_runner.py so both processes share behavior.
worker.future_plan: Remove together with platform patch.

worker.why: Ascend NPUs do not support UVA.
worker.how: Make UvaBuffer a dummy class mimicking the vLLM interface.
worker.future_plan: Remove when NPU supports UVA.

worker.why: Same-checkpoint DSpark drafts (e.g. DeepSeek-V4 MTP) reuse target weights and declare no quantization; upstream get_draft_quant_config returns None, so a W4A8/W8A8 checkpoint cannot load (KeyError on weight_offset/weight_scale/scale_bias).
worker.how: Temporarily redirect get_draft_quant_config to the target quant config during load_dspark_model for same-checkpoint drafts, then restore.
worker.future_plan: Remove once upstream load_dspark_model inherits target quant config.

worker.why: Upstream allocator is wrapped by torch.compile (unsupported on Ascend); A5 index_fill_ converts device indices to host vector causing sync.
worker.how: Run allocator eagerly and scope a TorchFunctionMode to route only index_fill_ through DeviceOperator (scatter_ on A5).
worker.future_plan: Remove after A5 native index_fill_ avoids sync and compiled allocator is supported.

worker.why: Upstream filters per-layer cache values by cache.device but Ascend allocates K/V tuples and Conv/SSM lists; returning only the first tensor drops V/SSM from connector cache entries.
worker.how: Flatten only the runner's cache list before device filtering, preserving original dict/container types; rebind copy_kv_cache_blocks_inplace to the Ascend segmented-copy implementation.
worker.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports multi-tensor allocations during device filtering.

steps: 在 vllm/model_executor/models/ 下创建模型文件
在 vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py 中注册
在 vllm/config/model.py 中添加架构默认值（如需要）
添加测试：tests/models/
在 vllm/config/ 对应配置类中添加字段（使用 @dataclass + config 元数据）
在 vllm/engine/arg_utils.py 中添加 CLI 参数（映射到配置字段）
添加测试
在 vllm/platforms/ 中创建新的 Platform 子类
通过 vllm.platform_plugins entry point 注册
实现平台特定的 attention、worker、通信等
在 vllm_ascend/patch/platform/ 中创建 patch 文件
实现 monkey-patch 逻辑（修改上游 vLLM 的类/函数）
在 vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py 中添加文档（what/why/how/related PR/future plan）
Patch 会被 adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True) 自动发现和加载
在 vllm_ascend/patch/worker/ 中创建 patch 文件
实现 monkey-patch 逻辑
在 vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py 中添加文档（同上）
Patch 会被 adapt_patch(is_global_patch=False) 自动发现和加载
评估是否需要 patch：attention 替换 → worker patch；修改 forward → worker patch；结构差异大 → 在 vllm_ascend/models/ 中创建 NPU 特有实现
添加 worker patch（如 patch_<model_name>.py）
在 vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py 中记录
添加测试：tests/e2e/models/
在 vllm_ascend/envs.py 的 env_variables 字典中添加
命名遵循 VLLM_ASCEND_* 规范
添加文档注释（默认值、有效范围、是否敏感）
在代码中通过 from vllm_ascend import envs 引用，禁止硬编码环境变量名
在 vllm_ascend/attention/ 中创建新的 attention 实现
继承 vllm_ascend/attention/abstract.py 中的基类
在 vllm_ascend/attention/__init__.py 中注册

vllm.environment_setup: cd ~/code/vllm && source .venv/bin/activate && uv pip install -r requirements/test/cuda.txt

env_variables.note: vLLM-ascend also consumes many upstream vLLM env vars (VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER, VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT, VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT, VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH, VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS). Per AGENTS.md, new Ascend env vars must be defined here with VLLM_ASCEND_* naming and documentation.
